A Busy Monday: 周一总是一周里最忙的一天:赶公交、十分钟回邮件、午饭只有三明治,晚上还有一小时网课。
Monday is always the busiest day of my week. I get up at six, drink a cup of coffee, and take the 7:15 bus to the office. Before I sit down, there are ten emails waiting for me on the screen.

At noon, I only have thirty minutes for lunch, so I usually buy a sandwich at the shop next door. I eat it quickly and hurry back to my desk. My friends often ask why I don't slow down, but on Mondays there is no time to rest.
In the evening, I have an online English class from eight to nine. After the class, I feel tired but happy, because Monday means a new start. Then I go to bed early, ready for Tuesday.
